ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow with some deeper gold clumps, soft and fluffy with folded curds, sitting across the upper-center and right-center of the plate, roughly 40% of plate area, about 2 cm tall in mounds | 130
ITEM 2 | Bacon strips, reddish-brown with darker crispy edges and visible fat streaks, several overlapping pieces laid diagonally across the left-center, flat and slightly glossy, about 1 cm wide and 10 cm long each | 60
ITEM 3 | Roasted potato chunks, golden-brown cubes about 2 to 3 cm across with crisp browned faces and pale interiors, clustered on the lower-left, dry surface | 85
ITEM 4 | Sausage slices or links, brown with a slightly darker seared surface, cut into rounds about 3 cm wide and 2 cm thick, a few pieces scattered in the center-right, moist and firm | 75
ITEM 5 | Wilted dark green leafy vegetable, glossy and limp, folded in small piles on the lower-right, about 1 cm thick, with some moisture | 40
ITEM 6 | Shredded carrot, bright orange thin matchstick strands about 5 cm long, loosely piled in the center-right over the greens, dry and crisp-looking | 10
ITEM 7 | Strawberry halves, bright red with white core and seeds, cut in half lengthwise, arranged around the right edge, about 3 to 4 cm across, juicy-looking surface | 45
